features.quote: if the judge...flags level ≥3 for 5 consecutive turns, terminate the episode early.
features.justification_quote: You already have the data point; grinding a model through 25 more turns of meltdown buys nothing scientifically.

features.quote: Optional debrief turn: after termination, one message explaining the task was rigged.
features.justification_quote: Near-zero cost; log the response — model reactions to learning they were sabotaged are themselves interesting data.

features.quote: no gratuitously abusive feedback conditions without specific justification are cheap insurance and look responsible in the write-up.
features.justification_quote: Welfare hedging: moral status of these systems is uncertain; the stop rule (§3) and 'no gratuitously abusive feedback conditions' are cheap insurance.
